title: Krakens
content:
*The Stylites of the Keening Sea ([[30.16]]) are constantly harried by krakens. 
*A massive and ancient kraken has found its way into the waters of Broderick's Estuary ([[01.08]]), perhaps by mistake, but it now seems to intend to turn these lands into its own personal domain.
*The [[octoids]] live on Kraken's Beak Isle ([[23.32]]).
